name: note_overview
label:
This form is to be used by field data teams to capture data according to the PVN **herbaceous vegetation** protocol.

Refer to the appropriate Standard Operating Procedures to guide you through the data collection process.

**Complete this form before leaving the plot** Refrain from using *Save as Draft* and select *Send* when you have finished collecting your data.

** 💡 Tip** To remove a selection in ODK Collect, press and hold down on the question text to *Remove response*.

label:
New Record: **${auto_new_unknown_label}**

This is the entity name. Use it consistently in all plots for the same specimen.

label: Input the **canonical species name** not included in the herbaceous species list:

name: note_new_missing
label:
**Important**

You recorded **${new_missing_canonical}** as a new missing species. It has been assigned the entity ID **${auto_new_missing_label}**.

If you encounter this species again in another quadrat in **THIS PLOT** (**during this submission**), you will see it listed as **${auto_new_missing_label}** in the reuse picker — *not* by its canonical name. 

The canonical name is saved and will appear **future plots** after submission of this form.

name: note_images
label: Take at least one close-up photograph of the herbaceous plant to capture the leaf arrangement, flowers, seeds, etc. Highly recommended for all species without an existing high-performing classifier and required if marked as **unknown**.
